title: Cladding funding extended to low-rise buildings
summary:
The Government has extended cladding funding to buildings under 11 metres for the first time, prioritising properties by risk level rather than height. Campaign groups have warned that limited funding may create further delays for affected leaseholders.

title: South-facing gardens command £20,000 premium despite heat
summary:
South-facing gardens continue to command a price premium of approximately £20,000, or 7%, despite homeowners increasingly avoiding outdoor spaces during recent heatwaves. Research from Yopa shows 82% of homeowners still prefer south-facing gardens, though 18% believe frequent heatwaves will reduce their desirability over the next decade.

title: CJ Hole relocates Burnham-on-Sea branch to new premises
summary:
Estate agency CJ Hole has relocated its Burnham-on-Sea branch to new premises in Somerset, marking the 12th office for franchise owner Chris Hill. The office opened on 3 July and will continue to provide sales, lettings and property management services to the local area.

title: FCA opened single mortgage fraud investigation in 2025
summary:
The Financial Conduct Authority opened just one enforcement investigation into mortgage fraud in 2025, according to Freedom of Information data. The figure marks a significant decline from three to four cases per year in previous years.

title: Mortgage industry calls for policy reform as 3.5m locked out
summary:
The mortgage lending industry has called for policy intervention to address barriers preventing an estimated 3.5 million households from accessing homeownership. IMLA has endorsed research indicating younger generations could face a £1.6 million wealth gap by retirement if excluded from the property market.

The post Mortgage industry calls for policy reform as 3.5m locked out appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: New build housing listings fall to lowest level since 2017
summary:
The number of new build housing developments listed for sale has fallen to its lowest level since 2017, according to property portal Rightmove. The decline raises questions about the Government's target to deliver 1.5 million homes during the current Parliament.

title: Maslow Capital provides €21.3m for Cork hotel project
summary:
Maslow Capital has provided a €21.3 million senior development facility to JMK Group for a 103-key extended-stay hotel in Cork's Georgian Quarter. The development is scheduled for completion in December 2027.

The post Maslow Capital provides €21.3m for Cork hotel project appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Inherited property faces £120,000 tax bill under reforms
summary:
Property owners could face tax bills of nearly £120,000 on inherited homes under proposed capital gains tax reforms, according to analysis from Rathbones. The research examines the removal of CGT uplift on death and alignment of rates with income tax bands.

The post Inherited property faces £120,000 tax bill under reforms appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Stamp duty costs deter homeowners from moving, data shows
summary:
Stamp duty costs are preventing homeowners from moving, according to analysis from property portal Zoopla, with bills reaching five figures across southern England. Regional data shows average costs of £20,000 in London compared to £2,200 in northern regions.

title: Winkworth appoints Oracle Group for national PR strategy
summary:
Estate agency franchise Winkworth has appointed The Oracle Group to manage its public relations and communications strategy across its UK and international operations. The appointment marks a strategic move by the London-based agency network to enhance its national profile whilst maintaining focus on the local expertise of its franchise offices.
